decisions.what: Appended services section styles before the existing prefers-reduced-motion block in styles.css
decisions.why: Preserved existing cascade order (tokens -> base -> components -> media queries) by keeping the reduced-motion query last.

decisions.what: Added stagger delay selectors for both .service-card:nth-child(N) (spec-literal) and .services-grid > li:nth-child(N) .service-card (DOM-accurate)
decisions.why: Existing markup wraps each service-card in an <li>, so a direct nth-child on the card would always be 1; supplying both selectors matches the actual DOM while retaining the literal selector called for in the spec.
Without this override, users with reduced motion would see the content permanently hidden because the animation is stripped but the initial opacity: 0 would remain.

decisions.what: Left the existing <script src=\"scripts.js\" defer> tag in index.html untouched and only added 'reveal' class to the six service cards
decisions.why: The script tag was already present with the exact placement and attributes described in the spec (marked with the ARVAD comment); only the reveal class needed to be added.

decisions.what: IntersectionObserver disconnects after every observed element has activated; per-entry unobserve() runs on intersection
decisions.why: Spec requires disconnecting the observer after animations to improve performance.

decisions.what: Fallback path adds 'active' class immediately when IntersectionObserver is unsupported
decisions.why: Spec explicitly requires the fallback so content remains visible on older browsers.
